inspiration.observed_pattern: OCTET_LENGTH measures the byte length of a multibyte string.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored scalar OCTET_LENGTH projection over a fixed accented literal, removing table setup, character-length comparison, NULL handling, and CASE classification while retaining the LONGLONG metadata contract.

fixture_notes: The fixed literal café isolates byte-length evaluation and LONGLONG result metadata.
determinism_notes: The text literal is fixed; the scalar query has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
